headline: The bed the phone could hear
lede: PINBALL's SOLO ostinato drowned under bumper volley on phone speakers — measured, not guessed: its bass sits 14–22 dB under the knee of a phone speaker and its melody idles most of the bar. The fix was voicing, not volume: a new mid-range voice walks the same minor progression right where small speakers carry, while the swell law keeps every contract value.

notes.text: SOLO bed rides a root–5th ostinato (A3·E4 · G3·D4 · F3·C4 · E3·B3, 164–330 Hz) — pinballcheck 279/279 with +12 mix pins, 14/14 mutants, pinballplay 64/64 including three live phone-mix legs, the 160–340 Hz band now occupied through most of every loop.
The tilt filter-muffle half of the tail stays parked at #3335 — no building against an open decision; the slump stays level-only until Jon answers.

Red main cleared: GALAGA's attract scrim shipped at /35 and the ≥40 legibility law has failed static on every main push since #3382 — one-token restore (#3397). main-ok missed it because the nightly predates the break; PR static is the earliest truth.

Observing is never neutral: a five-second passive sampling window between physics rigs let a free-running ball spend the magnet's charge — moving it after the restart leg (idle ball, clean bed) took the suite from flaky-red to 64/64.
